performance.verdict: CPL at $11.90 is efficient, but August volume risk is real.

findings.text: CPL improved to $8.96 effective rate over last 7d (spend -32.93% vs leads -9.37%), but daily spend at $40.83 may be too thin to sustain August scoreboard volume.
OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) still open; without it, lead-to-patient journey on the August scoreboard cannot be traced.
OVERDUE: Sync items + contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) unresolved; 255 GHL contacts with 81 opps created and 0 won signals intake data is still unreliable.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17): spend averaged $31.49/day and leads totaled 12, vs prior 3 days (Aug 12–14) averaging $42.87/day and 13 leads — a spend contraction, not a creative failure.
GHL pipeline shows 0 appointments and 0 won opportunities against 81 created in 28 days; leads are arriving but not converting in CRM — intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget ~20% (from ~$41/day to ~$49/day) to recover volume without breaking $11.90 CPL baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: Daily Meta spend has contracted to $31.49 avg over the last 3 days, pulling leads down while CPL remains healthy at $11.90 over 28 days. Raise the daily budget from ~$41 to ~$49 to recover lead volume. Success check: CPL stays at or below $12.50 and leads return to 5+/day average. Re-check by 2026-08-21.

suggestions.text: Close the phone-match attribution gap (overdue since 2026-08-07) so lead-to-patient tracking is valid for August renewal decision.
suggestions.monday_update: The phone-match attribution task was due 2026-08-07 and remains open. Without it, the August scoreboard — legitimate leads → schedules → shows → new patients — cannot be verified for the client's renewal decision. Attribution team must close and confirm by 2026-08-21. Success check: at least one tracked call correctly maps to a GHL contact with source attribution.

suggestions.text: Resolve GHL sync + contact cleanup (overdue 2026-08-14) to unblock 0-won-opp pipeline and expose true intake conversion rate.

CRM team must complete sync repairs and tagging so intake performance is visible before the August prove-it decision. Success check: at least one opportunity moves to a won or scheduled stage by 2026-08-22.
